notes: All 29 source and 33 target IDs are partitioned exactly once.

עוֹלָם is rendered attributively as everlasting here, so rule 28 governs rather than rule 19's for ever — the same construct is split the other way at vv. 29 and 31 because the ASV wrote it differently there.
The resultative לְ is unrepresented under rules 21 and 40, הָיָה having taken the copula.
מִן → because of is headed on because (rule 24), and כַּאֲשֶׁר fuses to as headed on the comparative preposition (rule 30).
